battle_traits.name: Blood-drenched
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Skulls for the Skull Throne' ability
battle_traits.effect: After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a BLOOD TITHE ability this turn, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:

options.name: Wild-eyed Brutality
options.text: Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.

options.name: Blood Haze
options.text: If the target is BLOODBOUND, its Blood-hungry weapons have Crit (Mortal).

options.name: Weapons of Murder
options.text: If the target is a non-MONSTER DAEMON unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its Blood-hungry weapons, including Blood-hungry Companion weapons.

options.name: Bloodlords Supreme
options.text: If the target is a MONSTER, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its Blood-hungry weapons.

battle_traits.name: Blood for the Blood God
battle_traits.effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock BLOOD TITHE abilities. You can only use BLOOD TITHE abilities that are unlocked. Once a BLOOD TITHE ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.

battle_traits.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne
battle_traits.effect: Pick a BLOOD TITHE ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability. That BLOOD TITHE ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.

battle_traits.name: Murderlust
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that CHARGE ability after that ability is resolved.

battle_traits.name: Divine Scorn
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy WIZARDS or PRIESTS within 6" of any friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units to be the target(s).
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.

battle_traits.name: Punish the Pacifist
battle_traits.declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy MANIFESTATION that is not in combat is a target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.

battle_traits.name: Murder the Mystic
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 4 enemy MANIFESTATIONS to be the target(s).
battle_traits.effect: Make a banishment roll of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that MANIFESTATION's warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is banished and removed from play.

battle_traits.name: Glorious Combat or Naught
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units.

battle_traits.name: Revel in Battle
battle_traits.effect: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit have no effect.

battle_traits.name: Slaughter Triumphant
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units that charged in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units.

abilities.name: Butchers of Nations
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly BLOODBOUND unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Tireless Conquerors
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BLOODBOUND units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: Drawn to Carnage
abilities.effect: Add X to charge rolls for friendly BLADES OF KHORNE units, where X is the number of friendly BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY or MONSTER units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.

abilities.name: Eager Killers
abilities.effect: Each friendly BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit that has used a FIGHT ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Bloody Competitors
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO BLOODBOUND unit and a friendly non-HERO BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets' combat attacks.

abilities.name: Tide of Savagery
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly BLOODBOUND HERO and up to 2 other friendly BLOODBOUND units that are wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 2" to the targets' Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Magical Scorn
entries.effect:
Subtract 1 from casting rolls for WIZARDS while they are within 12" of this unit.
Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy PRIESTS while they are within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Frenzied Taskmaster
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit within this unit's combat range that is not in combat to be the target.
entries.effect: The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit's combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.name: Skull Collector
entries.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy HERO by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy HERO has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

entries.name: Collar of Contempt
entries.effect: This unit can use UNBIND abilities as if it had WIZARD (1). Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

entries.name: Butcher's Blade
entries.declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets.
entries.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.name: Ar'gath, the King of Blades
entries.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy HEROES while they are in combat with this unit.

entries.name: Brass Flesh
entries.effect: Unmodified save rolls of 5+ for this unit cannot fail.

entries.name: Scorpion Tails
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• If the target unit's starting size was 1, subtract 1 from wound rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Blade-Limbs
entries.effect: Each time this unit is picked to use the 'Eruption of Fury' ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for the attacks made as part of that ability, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.

entries.name: Summon Hexgorger Skulls
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Hexgorger Skulls invocation on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Hexgorger Skulls invocation wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Hexgorger Skulls invocation has 2 parts that must be set up within 8" of each other.

entries.name: Summon Wrath-axe
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Wrath-axe on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Wrath-axe wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Bleeding Icon
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Bleeding Icon on the battlefield, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Bleeding Icon wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.

entries.name: Uncontrollable Rage
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability (see 'Battle Traits') apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of 'Wild-eyed Brutality' on the target.

entries.name: Blood Boil
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Final Act of Violence
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll as 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Goreflesh
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: Runes of Loathing
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has WARD (3+) against damage inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities, and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS (including FIGHT abilities). If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: Gift of Apoplexy
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a MOVE, CHARGE, or FIGHT ability, after that ability is resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.

entries.name: Gift of Apoplexy
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a MOVE or FIGHT ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.

entries.name: Stoke the Flames
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly BLADES OF KHORNE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with the target, your opponent cannot spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability.
• If the target is destroyed, you gain 1 rage dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, you gain 2 rage dice instead.

entries.name: Fetters of Blood
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• The targets cannot use RETREAT or RUN abilities.
• The targets cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow them to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.
